paragraphs: Sheila bar Avina (see above, Rav Assi, a remarkable matter). Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ben Sorer, has bar Bina. Rav Tahlifa said that Rav Sheila bar Avina said in Rav’s name: Avodah Zarah 22b. The same teaching at 15a has bar Avimi. She'erit Yosef brings Sheila bar Avimi and Sheila bar R' Avina among Rav's pupils, without seeing that one is a scribal error; accordingly Yuhasin brought only one.
